You hear an announcement on the TV in the middle of the night about a serial killer who recently escaped from an asylum and is now stalking your neighborhood. You start to feel anxious after hearing this.

You hear a lock crack behind you, turn to the front door and see it wide open with the lock pulled out and flung on the ground. You also see that the door is completely opened. Finally, you sense an unsettling presence behind you while being touched by something behind you...
